name: Arpeggio ~Kimi Iro no Melody~
original_name: あるぺじお～きみいろのメロディ～
source:
Riku, who wants to be a professional violinist, is in love with Chisato, the most beautiful girl at school. He has no connection with her, just looking at her every day. One day, they accidentally get to know each other, and their relationship becomes closer and more intimate. Involving Kai, his older brother, and Narumi, Chisato's closest friend, a pure love story starts....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
立志成为职业小提琴家的陆，爱上了学校里最美丽的少女千里。他与她毫无交集，只能每天远远注视。一天，两人偶然相识，关系也变得越来越亲近。随着陆的哥哥海与千里最亲密的朋友成美被卷入其中，一段纯爱故事就此开始……

[摘自ErogeShop]
